title: from reviews to revenue: the power of electronic word-of-mouth (ewom) and brand image in shaping consumer purchase intentions
core_idea: Examine how electronic word-of-mouth (eWOM) influences consumer purchase intention (PI) for herbal cosmetics, analyze the mediating role of brand image (BI), and account for environmental aspects by surveying young users and modeling relationships via structural equation analysis (SmartPLS) on data from 482 online consumers.
tldr: Study investigates whether and how eWOM shapes young consumers' purchase intentions for herbal cosmetics and whether brand image mediates that relationship, using a 482-respondent survey and structural modeling.
